honest_caveats: DEPLOY SIGNAL TODAY. Unlike the prior several runs, the site shipped a real deploy this cycle: sw.js CACHE_VERSION advanced v33 -> v39 (six bumps — booking-handoff card, dark Coda newsletter panel, PeakAlertHook removal, kinetic-hero word-wrap, BookingHandoff 'Tours and experiences' block + affiliate disclosure, newsletter conversion pass). Random sample: 10 destinations from the 505-EN-destination corpus (~2%), drawn via shuf with a sha256('nakshiq-qa-2026-05-22') random source for reproducibility. This run switched from the prior `yes <date>` seed (which produced near-identical day-to-day samples) to a hashed seed for genuine day-to-day variance — today's sample (medak/nelliyampathy/alleppey/chaukori/dhanaulti/namchi/kutch/minicoy/tadoba/belum-caves) overlaps the 2026-05-21 sample by only 1 slug (belum-caves) and spans 8 states/UTs (Telangana, Kerala x2, Uttarakhand x2, Sikkim, Gujarat, Lakshadweep, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh).

TTFB for destinations is curl-from-sandbox, not 4G mobile Lighthouse. Useful as a relative comparison + hot/cold cache signal, not absolute web-vitals. Today's destination median (2678 ms) is in the same band as 2026-05-21 (2766 ms). Destination HTML payloads grew this cycle (rishikesh 521 948 bytes vs 486 586 on 2026-05-21) consistent with the booking-card markup additions.
